literal_meaning: সোনার তৈরি পাথরের বাটি (a mortar made of gold, which is contradictory as mortars are typically stone)
similar_in_english: The moon made of green cheese
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কথা শুনে মনে হলো এটা সোনার পাথরবাটি, কখনো সম্ভব নয়।
এই প্রকল্পটি সোনার পাথরবাটির মতো, বাস্তবে অসম্ভব।
example_sentences_in_english: Hearing his words, it seemed like a golden stone mortar—utterly impossible.
This project is like a golden stone mortar; it's simply not feasible in reality.
note: This idiom draws on the inherent contradiction of material properties to emphasize impossibility, common in oral Bengali traditions.
